Through extensive evaluations on LLaVA and Qwen-VL models, we show that our diverse multi-image reasoning data significantly enhances multi-image reasoning performance, yielding significant improvements over baseline methods across benchmarks. Importantly, our approach maintains strong single-image reasoning performance while simultaneously strengthening multi-image understanding capabilities, thus advancing the state of the art for holistic visual preference alignment.

</details>


### [268] [UDM-GRPO: Stable and Efficient Group Relative Policy Optimization for Uniform Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18518)
*Jiaqi Wang,Haoge Deng,Ting Pan,Yang Liu,Chengyuan Wang,Fan Zhang,Yonggang Qi,Xinlong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UDM-GRPO框架首次将均匀离散扩散模型与强化学习结合，通过将最终干净样本作为动作、通过扩散前向过程重构轨迹等创新方法，解决了训练不稳定问题，在多个T2I任务上显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 均匀离散扩散模型在离散生成建模中表现出潜力，但其与强化学习的结合尚未充分探索。现有方法（如GRPO）直接应用于UDM会导致训练不稳定和性能提升有限，需要专门设计框架来解决这些问题。

Method: 提出UDM-GRPO框架，核心创新包括：1）将最终干净样本作为动作提供更准确稳定的优化信号；2）通过扩散前向过程重构轨迹，使概率路径与预训练分布更好对齐；3）引入Reduced-Step和CFG-Free策略提升训练效率。

Result: 在多个文本到图像任务上显著提升基础模型性能：GenEval准确率从69%提升到96%，PickScore从20.46提升到23.81，在连续和离散设置下均达到最先进水平。OCR基准测试准确率从8%提升到57%，验证了方法的泛化能力。

Conclusion: UDM-GRPO成功将均匀离散扩散模型与强化学习结合，通过创新的优化策略解决了训练不稳定问题，在多个基准测试中取得显著性能提升，为离散生成建模与强化学习的结合提供了有效框架。

Abstract: Uniform Discrete Diffusion Model (UDM) has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for discrete generative modeling; however, its integration with reinforcement learning remains largely unexplored. We observe that naively applying GRPO to UDM leads to training instability and marginal performance gains. To address this, we propose \Ours, the first framework to integrate UDM with RL. Our method is guided by two key insights: (i) treating the final clean sample as the action provides more accurate and stable optimization signals; and (ii) reconstructing trajectories via the diffusion forward process better aligns probability paths with the pretraining distribution. Additionally, we introduce two strategies, Reduced-Step and CFG-Free, to further improve training efficiency. \Ours significantly improves base model performance across multiple T2I tasks. Notably, GenEval accuracy improves from $69\%$ to $96\%$ and PickScore increases from $20.46$ to $23.81$, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both continuous and discrete settings. On the OCR benchmark, accuracy rises from $8\%$ to $57\%$, further validating the generalization ability of our method. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Yovecent/UDM-GRPO}{https://github.com/Yovecent/UDM-GRPO}.

</details>


### [269] [MetaCloak-JPEG: JPEG-Robust Adversarial Perturbation for Preventing Unauthorized DreamBooth-Based Deepfake Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18537)
*Tanjim Rahaman Fardin,S M Zunaid Alam,Mahadi Hasan Fahim,Md Faysal Mahfuz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MetaCloak-JPEG通过引入可微JPEG层解决现有对抗性人脸保护系统在社交媒体JPEG压缩下的失效问题，显著提升保护效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗性人脸保护系统（PhotoGuard、Anti-DreamBooth、MetaCloak）存在结构性盲点：未考虑社交媒体平台普遍应用的JPEG压缩。由于JPEG量化使用round()函数（导数几乎处处为零），对抗性扰动集中在高频DCT频段，而JPEG会丢弃这些频段，导致60-80%的保护信号失效。

Method: 提出MetaCloak-JPEG，核心是插入基于直通估计器（STE）的可微JPEG（DiffJPEG）层：前向传播应用标准JPEG压缩，反向传播将round()替换为恒等函数。将DiffJPEG嵌入JPEG感知的EOT分布（约70%增强包含DiffJPEG）和课程质量因子调度（QF: 95到50），在双层元学习循环中训练。

Result: 在l-inf扰动预算eps=8/255下，MetaCloak-JPEG达到32.7 dB PSNR，91.3%的JPEG存活率，在评估的9个JPEG质量因子中全面优于PhotoGuard（9/9胜出，平均去噪损失增益+0.125），训练内存预算为4.1 GB。

Conclusion: MetaCloak-JPEG通过解决JPEG压缩下的梯度传播问题，显著提升了对抗性人脸保护系统在真实社交媒体环境中的有效性，填补了现有方法的盲点。

Abstract: The rapid progress of subject-driven text-to-image synthesis, and in particular DreamBooth, has enabled a consent-free deepfake pipeline: an adversary needs only 4-8 publicly available face images to fine-tune a personalized diffusion model and produce photorealistic harmful content. Current adversarial face-protection systems -- PhotoGuard, Anti-DreamBooth, and MetaCloak -- perturb user images to disrupt surrogate fine-tuning, but all share a structural blindness: none backpropagates gradients through the JPEG compression pipeline that every major social-media platform applies before adversary access. Because JPEG quantization relies on round(), whose derivative is zero almost everywhere, adversarial energy concentrates in high-frequency DCT bands that JPEG discards, eliminating 60-80% of the protective signal. We introduce MetaCloak-JPEG, which closes this gap by inserting a Differentiable JPEG (DiffJPEG) layer built on the Straight-Through Estimator (STE): the forward pass applies standard JPEG compression, while the backward pass replaces round() with the identity. DiffJPEG is embedded in a JPEG-aware EOT distribution (~70% of augmentations include DiffJPEG) and a curriculum quality-factor schedule (QF: 95 to 50) inside a bilevel meta-learning loop. Under an l-inf perturbation budget of eps=8/255, MetaCloak-JPEG attains 32.7 dB PSNR, a 91.3% JPEG survival rate, and outperforms PhotoGuard on all 9 evaluated JPEG quality factors (9/9 wins, mean denoising-loss gain +0.125) within a 4.1 GB training-memory budget.

</details>


### [270] [Advancing Vision Transformer with Enhanced Spatial Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18549)
*Qihang Fan,Huaibo Huang,Mingrui Chen,Hongmin Liu,Ran He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EVT是RMT的改进版本，使用欧几里得距离衰减增强空间信息建模，采用空间独立分组方法，在多种视觉任务上表现优异，ImageNet-1k达到86.6% top1准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Vision Transformer的自注意力机制缺乏显式空间先验且计算复杂度高，限制了其应用。RMT虽然解决了部分问题，但仍有改进空间。

Method: 1. 使用欧几里得距离衰减增强空间信息建模；2. 放弃分解注意力机制，采用空间独立分组方法；3. 保持RMT的基本架构但进行关键改进。

Result: 在ImageNet-1k上达到86.6% top1准确率（无需额外训练数据），在图像分类、目标检测、实例分割和语义分割等任务上表现优异。

Conclusion: EVT通过更合理的欧几里得距离衰减和灵活的分组策略，克服了RMT的局限性，为自注意力机制提供了更先进的空间先验建模方法，在多种计算机视觉任务中表现出色。

Abstract: In recent years, the Vision Transformer (ViT) has garnered significant attention within the computer vision community. However, the core component of ViT, Self-Attention, lacks explicit spatial priors and suffers from quadratic computational complexity, limiting its applicability. To address these issues, we have proposed RMT, a robust vision backbone with explicit spatial priors for general purposes. RMT utilizes Manhattan distance decay to introduce spatial information and employs a horizontal and vertical decomposition attention method to model global information. Building on the strengths of RMT, Euclidean enhanced Vision Transformer (EVT) is an expanded version that incorporates several key improvements. Firstly, EVT uses a more reasonable Euclidean distance decay to enhance the modeling of spatial information, allowing for a more accurate representation of spatial relationships compared to the Manhattan distance used in RMT. Secondly, EVT abandons the decomposed attention mechanism featured in RMT and instead adopts a simpler spatially-independent grouping approach, providing the model with greater flexibility in controlling the number of tokens within each group. By addressing these modifications, EVT offers a more sophisticated and adaptable approach to incorporating spatial priors into the Self-Attention mechanism, thus overcoming some of the limitations associated with RMT and further enhancing its applicability in various computer vision tasks. Extensive experiments on Image Classification, Object Detection, Instance Segmentation, and Semantic Segmentation demonstrate that EVT exhibits exceptional performance. Without additional training data, EVT achieves 86.6% top1-acc on ImageNet-1k.

</details>


### [271] [SynAgent: Generalizable Cooperative Humanoid Manipulation via Solo-to-Cooperative Agent Synergy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18557)
*Wei Yao,Haohan Ma,Hongwen Zhang,Yunlian Sun,Liangjun Xing,Zhile Yang,Yuanjun Guo,Yebin Liu,Jinhui Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SynAgent：通过单智能体到多智能体技能迁移实现可扩展的物理合理协作操纵的统一框架


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可控协作人形操纵是具身智能的基础但具有挑战性的问题，主要面临数据稀缺、多智能体协调复杂以及跨对象泛化能力有限等困难

Method: 1. 基于Delaunay四面体化的交互网格进行交互保持重定向；2. 单智能体预训练和适应范式，通过去中心化训练和多智能体PPO从丰富的单人数据中引导协作行为；3. 轨迹条件生成策略，使用条件VAE并通过多教师蒸馏训练实现稳定可控的对象级轨迹执行

Result: SynAgent在协作模仿和轨迹条件控制方面显著优于现有基线方法，并能泛化到不同的物体几何形状

Conclusion: SynAgent通过单智能体到协作智能体协同的框架，实现了可扩展且物理合理的协作操纵，为解决数据稀缺和协调复杂性提供了有效方案

Abstract: Controllable cooperative humanoid manipulation is a fundamental yet challenging problem for embodied intelligence, due to severe data scarcity, complexities in multi-agent coordination, and limited generalization across objects. In this paper, we present SynAgent, a unified framework that enables scalable and physically plausible cooperative manipulation by leveraging Solo-to-Cooperative Agent Synergy to transfer skills from single-agent human-object interaction to multi-agent human-object-human scenarios. To maintain semantic integrity during motion transfer, we introduce an interaction-preserving retargeting method based on an Interact Mesh constructed via Delaunay tetrahedralization, which faithfully maintains spatial relationships among humans and objects. Building upon this refined data, we propose a single-agent pretraining and adaptation paradigm that bootstraps synergistic collaborative behaviors from abundant single-human data through decentralized training and multi-agent PPO. Finally, we develop a trajectory-conditioned generative policy using a conditional VAE, trained via multi-teacher distillation from motion imitation priors to achieve stable and controllable object-level trajectory execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SynAgent significantly outperforms existing baselines in both cooperative imitation and trajectory-conditioned control, while generalizing across diverse object geometries. Codes and data will be available after publication. Project Page: http://yw0208.github.io/synagent

</details>


### [272] [AnchorSeg: Language Grounded Query Banks for Reasoning Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18562)
*Rui Qian,Chuanhang Deng,Qiang Huang,Jian Xiong,Mingxuan Li,Yingbo Zhou,Wei Zhai,Jintao Chen,Dejing Dou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AnchorSeg通过结构化查询银行将推理分割解耦为语义推理和空间定位，使用Token-Mask循环一致性实现跨分辨率对齐，在ReasonSeg上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖单个<SEG>标记隐式编码语义推理和空间定位，限制了模型显式解耦"分割什么"和"在哪里分割"的能力。

Method: 引入结构化查询银行：潜在推理标记捕获中间语义状态，分割锚点标记提供显式空间基础。将空间条件建模为图像标记的因子化分布，提出Token-Mask循环一致性实现跨分辨率对齐。

Result: 在ReasonSeg测试集上达到67.7% gIoU和68.1% cIoU，实现最先进性能。

Conclusion: 通过结构化语言基础查询银行显式解耦空间基础和语义推理，AnchorSeg显著提升了推理分割性能。

Abstract: Reasoning segmentation requires models to ground complex, implicit textual queries into precise pixel-level masks. Existing approaches rely on a single segmentation token $\texttt{<SEG>}$, whose hidden state implicitly encodes both semantic reasoning and spatial localization, limiting the model's ability to explicitly disentangle what to segment from where to segment. We introduce AnchorSeg, which reformulates reasoning segmentation as a structured conditional generation process over image tokens, conditioned on language grounded query banks. Instead of compressing all semantic reasoning and spatial localization into a single embedding, AnchorSeg constructs an ordered sequence of query banks: latent reasoning tokens that capture intermediate semantic states, and a segmentation anchor token that provides explicit spatial grounding. We model spatial conditioning as a factorized distribution over image tokens, where the anchor query determines localization signals while contextual queries provide semantic modulation. To bridge token-level predictions and pixel-level supervision, we propose Token--Mask Cycle Consistency (TMCC), a bidirectional training objective that enforces alignment across resolutions. By explicitly decoupling spatial grounding from semantic reasoning through structured language grounded query banks, AnchorSeg achieves state-of-the-art results on ReasonSeg test set (67.7\% gIoU and 68.1\% cIoU). All code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/rui-qian/AnchorSeg.

</details>


### [273] [MultiWorld: Scalable Multi-Agent Multi-View Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18564)
*Haoyu Wu,Jiwen Yu,Yingtian Zou,Xihui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MultiWorld：一个统一的多智能体多视角世界建模框架，能够准确控制多个智能体并保持多视角一致性，支持灵活扩展智能体和视角数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型主要局限于单智能体场景，无法捕捉真实世界多智能体系统中的复杂交互，需要开发能够处理多智能体多视角环境的世界建模方法。

Method: 提出MultiWorld框架，包含多智能体条件模块实现精确的多智能体可控性，以及全局状态编码器确保不同视角间的观测一致性；支持灵活扩展智能体和视角数量，并行合成不同视角以提高效率。

Result: 在多玩家游戏环境和多机器人操作任务上的实验表明，MultiWorld在视频保真度、动作跟随能力和多视角一致性方面优于基线方法。

Conclusion: MultiWorld成功解决了多智能体多视角世界建模的挑战，为复杂交互环境提供了有效的模拟框架，在多个关键指标上表现出优越性能。

Abstract: Video world models have achieved remarkable success in simulating environmental dynamics in response to actions by users or agents. They are modeled as action-conditioned video generation models that take historical frames and current actions as input to predict future frames. Yet, most existing approaches are limited to single-agent scenarios and fail to capture the complex interactions inherent in real-world multi-agent systems. We present \textbf{MultiWorld}, a unified framework for multi-agent multi-view world modeling that enables accurate control of multiple agents while maintaining multi-view consistency. We introduce the Multi-Agent Condition Module to achieve precise multi-agent controllability, and the Global State Encoder to ensure coherent observations across different views. MultiWorld supports flexible scaling of agent and view counts, and synthesizes different views in parallel for high efficiency. Experiments on multi-player game environments and multi-robot manipulation tasks demonstrate that MultiWorld outperforms baselines in video fidelity, action-following ability, and multi-view consistency. Project page: https://multi-world.github.io/

</details>


### [274] [T-REN: Learning Text-Aligned Region Tokens Improves Dense Vision-Language Alignment and Scalability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18573)
*Savya Khosla,Sethuraman T,Aryan Chadha,Alex Schwing,Derek Hoiem*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: T-REN提出了一种文本对齐的区域编码器网络，通过轻量级网络将视觉数据映射到紧凑的文本对齐区域级表示，显著提升跨模态理解能力并大幅减少token数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视觉语言编码器存在两个核心限制：1) 语言与密集视觉特征之间的对齐较弱，影响开放词汇语义分割等任务；2) 细粒度视觉表示的token数量过多，限制了在长视频中的可扩展性。

Method: 在冻结的视觉骨干网络之上添加轻量级网络，训练该网络将每个语义区域内的patch级表示池化为区域token，并与区域级文本标注对齐。仅增加3.7%的参数。

Result: 在多个任务上取得显著提升：ADE20K开放词汇分割+5.9 mIoU，COCO对象级文本图像检索+18.4%召回率，Ego4D视频对象定位+15.6%召回率，VSPW视频场景解析+17.6% mIoU，同时图像token减少24倍以上，视频token减少187倍以上。

Conclusion: T-REN通过高效的文本对齐区域编码，同时解决了视觉语言编码器的对齐问题和可扩展性问题，在保持参数效率的同时显著提升了跨模态理解性能。

Abstract: Despite recent progress, vision-language encoders struggle with two core limitations: (1) weak alignment between language and dense vision features, which hurts tasks like open-vocabulary semantic segmentation; and (2) high token counts for fine-grained visual representations, which limits scalability to long videos. This work addresses both limitations. We propose T-REN (Text-aligned Region Encoder Network), an efficient encoder that maps visual data to a compact set of text-aligned region-level representations (or region tokens). T-REN achieves this through a lightweight network added on top of a frozen vision backbone, trained to pool patch-level representations within each semantic region into region tokens and align them with region-level text annotations. With only 3.7% additional parameters compared to the vision-language backbone, this design yields substantially stronger dense cross-modal understanding while reducing the token count by orders of magnitude. Specifically, T-REN delivers +5.9 mIoU on ADE20K open-vocabulary segmentation, +18.4% recall on COCO object-level text-image retrieval, +15.6% recall on Ego4D video object localization, and +17.6% mIoU on VSPW video scene parsing, all while reducing token counts by more than 24x for images and 187x for videos compared to the patch-based vision-language backbone. The code and model are available at https://github.com/savya08/T-REN.

</details>


### [275] [ReCap: Lightweight Referential Grounding for Coherent Story Visualization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18575)
*Aditya Arora,Akshita Gupta,Pau Rodriguez,Marcus Rohrbach*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReCap是一个轻量级的故事可视化一致性框架，通过条件帧引用和语义漂移校正来提升角色稳定性和视觉保真度，仅增加14.9万参数，在多个基准测试中达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法依赖显式记忆库、架构扩展或辅助语言模型来保持跨帧一致性，导致参数大幅增长和推理开销。需要一种轻量级方法在不修改基础扩散模型的情况下提升角色一致性。

Method: 1. CORE模块：将代词作为视觉锚点，仅在角色被代词引用时激活，以前一帧为条件传播视觉身份，避免无条件跨帧条件化。2. SemDrift：仅在训练时应用，当文本模糊或指代不清时，通过将去噪器表示与预训练DINOv3视觉嵌入对齐来校正语义漂移。

Result: 在FlintstonesSV基准上Character-Accuracy提升2.63%，在PororoSV基准上提升5.65%，在两个主要故事可视化基准上都达到了新的SOTA。还能扩展到真实电影的人类中心叙事。

Conclusion: ReCap通过轻量级设计（仅14.9万额外参数）有效解决了故事可视化中的角色一致性问题，超越了传统内存库和LLM增强方法，并能扩展到卡通风格之外的领域。

Abstract: Story Visualization aims to generate a sequence of images that faithfully depicts a textual narrative that preserve character identity, spatial configuration, and stylistic coherence as the narratives unfold. Maintaining such cross-frame consistency has traditionally relied on explicit memory banks, architectural expansion, or auxiliary language models, resulting in substantial parameter growth and inference overhead. We introduce ReCap, a lightweight consistency framework that improves character stability and visual fidelity without modifying the base diffusion backbone. ReCap's CORE (COnditional frame REferencing) module treats anaphors, in our case pronouns, as visual anchors, activating only when characters are referred to by a pronoun and conditioning on the preceding frame to propagate visual identity. This selective design avoids unconditional cross-frame conditioning and introduces only 149K additional parameters, a fraction of the cost of memory-bank and LLM-augmented approaches. To further stabilize identity, we incorporate SemDrift (Guided Semantic Drift Correction) applied only during training. When text is vague or referential, the denoiser lacks a visual anchor for identity-defining attributes, causing character appearance to drift across frames, SemDrift corrects this by aligning denoiser representations with pretrained DINOv3 visual embeddings, enforcing semantic identity stability at zero inference cost. ReCap outperforms previous state-of-the-art, StoryGPT-V, on the two main benchmarks for story visualization by 2.63% Character-Accuracy on FlintstonesSV and by 5.65% on PororoSV, establishing a new state-of-the-art character consistency on both benchmarks. Furthermore, we extend story visualization to human-centric narratives derived from real films, demonstrating the capability of ReCap beyond stylized cartoon domains.

</details>


### [276] [MUA: Mobile Ultra-detailed Animatable Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18583)
*Heming Zhu,Guoxing Sun,Marc Habermann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Wavelet-guided Multi-level Spatial Factorized Blendshapes表示法和蒸馏流程，将高质量虚拟人模型压缩为轻量级版本，在保持视觉质量的同时大幅降低计算成本和模型大小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可动画虚拟人建模方法存在两极化问题：高保真模型需要服务器级GPU计算，而轻量级模型则表面动态有限、细节缺失且存在明显伪影。需要同时实现高保真和低计算成本的解决方案。

Method: 提出小波引导的多级空间因子化混合形状表示法，结合多级小波频谱分解和纹理空间低秩结构因子化，通过蒸馏流程将预训练高质量教师模型的运动感知衣物动态和细粒度外观细节转移到紧凑高效表示中。

Result: 相比原始高质量教师模型，计算成本降低2000倍，模型大小缩小10倍，同时保持视觉上合理的动态和外观细节。在桌面PC上达到180+FPS，在Meta Quest 3上实现24FPS实时性能，显著优于移动端现有方法，质量可与服务器端方法媲美。

Conclusion: 该方法成功填补了高保真虚拟人与轻量级部署之间的鸿沟，显著提升了高保真虚拟人在沉浸式应用中的实用性，实现了在资源受限平台上运行高质量虚拟人的突破。

Abstract: Building photorealistic, animatable full-body digital humans remains a longstanding challenge in computer graphics and vision. Recent advances in animatable avatar modeling have largely progressed along two directions: improving the fidelity of dynamic geometry and appearance, or reducing computational complexity to enable deployment on resource-constrained platforms, e.g., VR headsets. However, existing approaches fail to achieve both goals simultaneously: Ultra-high-fidelity avatars typically require substantial computation on server-class GPUs, whereas lightweight avatars often suffer from limited surface dynamics, reduced appearance details, and noticeable artifacts. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel animatable avatar representation, termed Wavelet-guided Multi-level Spatial Factorized Blendshapes, and a corresponding distillation pipeline that transfers motion-aware clothing dynamics and fine-grained appearance details from a pre-trained ultra-high-quality avatar model into a compact, efficient representation. By coupling multi-level wavelet spectral decomposition with low-rank structural factorization in texture space, our method achieves up to 2000X lower computational cost and a 10X smaller model size than the original high-quality teacher avatar model, while preserving visually plausible dynamics and appearance details closely resemble those of the teacher model. Extensive comparisons with state-of-the-art methods show that our approach significantly outperforms existing avatar approaches designed for mobile settings and achieves comparable or superior rendering quality to most approaches that can only run on servers. Importantly, our representation substantially improves the practicality of high-fidelity avatars for immersive applications, achieving over 180 FPS on a desktop PC and real-time native on-device performance at 24 FPS on a standalone Meta Quest 3.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [277] [Governing the Agentic Enterprise: A Governance Maturity Model for Managing AI Agent Sprawl in Business Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16338)
*Vivek Acharya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出AAGMM模型解决企业AI代理治理危机，通过五级成熟度框架和代理蔓延分类，显著改善业务成果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AI代理快速采用导致代理蔓延危机：冗余、无治理、冲突的AI代理激增。行业调查显示仅21%企业有成熟治理模型，40%项目预计因治理不足失败。学术文献缺乏连接治理能力与业务成果的实证验证模型。

Method: 提出Agentic AI Governance Maturity Model (AAGMM)：五级成熟度框架，涵盖12个治理领域，基于NIST AI RMF和ISO/IEC 42001标准。提出代理蔓延模式分类学：功能重复、影子代理、孤儿代理、权限蔓延、未监控委托链，每个模式关联量化业务成本模型。通过750次模拟运行验证框架，覆盖五个企业场景和五个治理成熟度级别。

Result: 结果显示治理成熟度级别间存在统计显著差异(p<0.001，效应量d>2.0)。Level 4-5组织相比Level 1：蔓延指数降低94.3%，风险事件减少96.4%，有效任务完成率提高32.6%。

Conclusion: AAGMM为从业者提供了治理自主AI代理的行动路线图，同时最大化业务回报，解决了企业AI代理治理的关键挑战。

Abstract: The rapid adoption of agentic AI in enterprise business operations--autonomous systems capable of planning, reasoning, and executing multi-step workflows--has created an urgent governance crisis. Organizations face uncontrolled agent sprawl: the proliferation of redundant, ungoverned, and conflicting AI agents across business functions. Industry surveys report that only 21% of enterprises have mature governance models for autonomous agents, while 40% of agentic AI projects are projected to fail by 2027 due to inadequate governance and risk controls. Despite growing acknowledgment of this challenge, academic literature lacks a formal, empirically validated governance maturity model connecting governance capability to measurable business outcomes. This paper introduces the Agentic AI Governance Maturity Model (AAGMM), a five-level framework spanning 12 governance domains, grounded in NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 standards. We additionally propose a novel taxonomy of agent sprawl patterns--functional duplication, shadow agents, orphaned agents, permission creep, and unmonitored delegation chains--each linked to quantifiable business cost models. The framework is validated through 750 simulation runs across five enterprise scenarios and five governance maturity levels, measuring business outcomes including cost containment, risk incident rates, operational efficiency, and decision quality. Results demonstrate statistically significant differences (p < 0.001, large effect sizes d > 2.0) between all governance maturity levels, with Level 4-5 organizations achieving 94.3% lower sprawl indices, 96.4% fewer risk incidents, and 32.6% higher effective task completion rates compared to Level 1. The AAGMM provides practitioners with an actionable roadmap for governing autonomous AI agents while maximizing business returns.

</details>


### [278] [Semantic Consensus: Process-Aware Conflict Detection and Resolution for Enterprise Multi-Agent LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16339)
*Vivek Acharya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对多智能体LLM系统在企业的失败率高问题，提出语义共识框架(SCF)来解决智能体间的语义意图分歧，显著提升工作流完成率至100%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AI自动化中多智能体LLM系统的失败率高达41%-86.7%，其中79%的失败源于规范和协调问题而非模型能力限制。语义意图分歧——合作LLM智能体因信息孤岛和缺乏流程模型而对共享目标产生不一致理解——是导致多智能体失败的主要但尚未正式解决的根本原因。

Method: 提出语义共识框架(SCF)，这是一个流程感知的中间件，包含六个组件：流程上下文层（共享操作语义）、语义意图图（形式化意图表示）、冲突检测引擎（实时识别矛盾、竞争和因果无效的意图组合）、共识解决协议（使用策略-权威-时间层次结构）、漂移监控器（检测渐进语义分歧）和流程感知治理集成层（组织策略执行）。

Result: 在三个多智能体框架(AutoGen、CrewAI、LangGraph)和四个企业场景的600次运行评估中，SCF是唯一实现100%工作流完成率的方法（次优基线为25.1%），同时检测到65.2%的语义冲突（精度27.9%），并提供完整的治理审计跟踪。该框架与协议无关，兼容MCP和A2A通信标准。

Conclusion: 语义共识框架(SCF)有效解决了多智能体LLM系统中的语义意图分歧问题，显著提高了企业AI自动化的可靠性和成功率，为多智能体协调提供了系统性的解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems are rapidly emerging as the dominant architecture for enterprise AI automation, yet production deployments exhibit failure rates between 41% and 86.7%, with nearly 79% of failures originating from specification and coordination issues rather than model capability limitations. This paper identifies Semantic Intent Divergence--the phenomenon whereby cooperating LLM agents develop inconsistent interpretations of shared objectives due to siloed context and absent process models--as a primary yet formally unaddressed root cause of multi-agent failure in enterprise settings. We propose the Semantic Consensus Framework (SCF), a process-aware middleware comprising six components: a Process Context Layer for shared operational semantics, a Semantic Intent Graph for formal intent representation, a Conflict Detection Engine for real-time identification of contradictory, contention-based, and causally invalid intent combinations, a Consensus Resolution Protocol using a policy--authority--temporal hierarchy, a Drift Monitor for detecting gradual semantic divergence, and a Process-Aware Governance Integration layer for organizational policy enforcement. Evaluation across 600 runs spanning three multi-agent frameworks (AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph) and four enterprise scenarios demonstrates that SCF is the only approach to achieve 100% workflow completion--compared to 25.1% for the next-best baseline--while detecting 65.2% of semantic conflicts with 27.9% precision and providing complete governance audit trails. The framework is protocol-agnostic and compatible with MCP and A2A communication standards.

</details>


### [279] [Computational Hermeneutics: Evaluating generative AI as a cultural technology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16403)
*Cody Kommers,Ruth Ahnert,Maria Antoniak,Emmanouil Benetos,Steve Benford,Mercedes Bunz,Baptiste Caramiaux,Shauna Concannon,Martin Disley,James Dobson,Yali Du,Edgar Duéñez-Guzmán,Kerry Francksen,Evelyn Gius,Jonathan W. Y. Gray,Ryan Heuser,Sarah Immel,Richard Jean So,Sang Leigh,Dalaki Livingston,Hoyt Long,Meredith Martin,Georgia Meyer,Daniela Mihai,Ashley Noel-Hirst,Kirsten Ostherr,Deven Parker,Yipeng Qin,Jessica Ratcliff,Emily Robinson,Karina Rodriguez,Adam Sobey,Ted Underwood,Aditya Vashistha,Matthew Wilkens,Youyou Wu,Yuan Zheng,Drew Hemment*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出生成式AI应被视为"文化技术"，而非仅测量文化变量。基于解释学理论，提出生成式AI是"情境机器"，面临三个解释挑战：情境性、多元性和模糊性。提出计算解释学框架，强调评估应迭代、包含人类参与、测量文化情境而非仅模型输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI评估框架将文化视为可测量的变量，而非系统运作的根本要素。生成式AI系统作为文化技术，需要更根本地处理文化解释问题。解释学理论提供了理解AI如何运作的新视角。

Method: 基于解释学理论，提出生成式AI是"情境机器"，必须处理三个解释挑战：1) 情境性（意义只在情境中产生）；2) 多元性（多种有效解释共存）；3) 模糊性（解释自然冲突）。提出计算解释学作为新兴框架。

Result: 提出三个解释学评估原则：1) 基准测试应是迭代的而非一次性的；2) 应包含人类参与而不仅仅是机器；3) 应测量文化情境而不仅仅是模型输出。这为AI系统设计和评估提供了新范式。

Conclusion: 该视角为当代AI系统设计和评估提供了新兴范式：从关于准确性的标准化问题转向关于意义的情境性问题。计算解释学框架提供了理解生成式AI系统运作的新方式，强调文化解释在AI系统中的根本重要性。

Abstract: Generative AI systems are increasingly recognized as cultural technologies, yet current evaluation frameworks often treat culture as a variable to be measured rather than fundamental to the system's operation. Drawing on hermeneutic theory from the humanities, we argue that GenAI systems function as "context machines" that must inherently address three interpretive challenges: situatedness (meaning only emerges in context), plurality (multiple valid interpretations coexist), and ambiguity (interpretations naturally conflict). We present computational hermeneutics as an emerging framework offering an interpretive account of what GenAI systems do, and how they might do it better. We offer three principles for hermeneutic evaluation -- that benchmarks should be iterative, not one-off; include people, not just machines; and measure cultural context, not just model output. This perspective offers a nascent paradigm for designing and evaluating contemporary AI systems: shifting from standardized questions about accuracy to contextual ones about meaning.

</details>


### [280] [Heterogeneous Self-Play for Realistic Highway Traffic Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16406)
*Jinkai Qiu,Alessandro Saviolo,Chaojie Wang,Mingke Wang,Xiaoyu Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PHASE是一个用于高速公路场景生成的自博弈框架，通过上下文感知和条件控制实现可控、多样且行为可信的多智能体交互，在未见过的真实场景中实现零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高速公路仿真对自动驾驶安全评估至关重要，但现有方法难以同时满足：1) 覆盖不同速度和机动动作的广泛场景；2) 可控生成罕见安全关键场景；3) 多智能体交互的行为可信度。

Method: 提出PHASE框架：基于上下文感知的自博弈，通过显式的智能体条件控制实现可控性，合成场景生成实现广泛覆盖，闭环多智能体训练实现真实交互动态。支持不同车辆类型，采用车辆感知动力学、上下文条件动作、早期终止、碰撞责任归属、高速公路奖励塑造、耦合课程学习和鲁棒策略优化等技术。

Result: 在512个未见过的真实场景中实现零样本迁移：成功率96.3%，ADE/FDE从6.57/12.07米降至2.44/5.25米。在轨迹嵌入空间中，比IDM模型减少Frèchet轨迹距离13.1%，能量距离20.2%。

Conclusion: 合成自博弈为可控且真实的高速公路场景生成提供了可扩展的途径，无需直接模仿专家日志数据，能够有效支持自动驾驶的安全评估。

Abstract: Realistic highway simulation is critical for scalable safety evaluation of autonomous vehicles, particularly for interactions that are too rare to study from logged data alone. Yet highway traffic generation remains challenging because it requires broad coverage across speeds and maneuvers, controllable generation of rare safety-critical scenarios, and behavioral credibility in multi-agent interactions. We present PHASE, Policy for Heterogeneous Agent Self-play on Expressway, a context-aware self-play framework that addresses these three requirements through explicit per-agent conditioning for controllability, synthetic scenario generation for broad highway coverage, and closed-loop multi-agent training for realistic interaction dynamics. PHASE further supports different vehicle profiles, for example, passenger cars and articulated trailer trucks, within a single policy via vehicle-aware dynamics and context-conditioned actions, and stabilizes self-play with early termination of unrecoverable states, at-fault collision attribution, highway-aware reward shaping, coupled curricula, and robust policy optimization. Despite being trained only on synthetic data, PHASE transfers zero-shot to 512 unseen high-interaction real scenarios in exiD, achieving a 96.3% success rate and reducing ADE/FDE from 6.57/12.07 m to 2.44/5.25 m relative to a prior self-play baseline. In a learned trajectory embedding space, it also improves behavioral realism over IDM, reducing Frechet trajectory distance by 13.1% and energy distance by 20.2%. These results show that synthetic self-play can provide a scalable route to controllable and realistic highway scenario generation without direct imitation of expert logs.

</details>


### [281] [Support Sufficiency as Consequence-Sensitive Compression in Belief Arbitration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16434)
*Mark Walsh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出支持感知控制状态的概念，认为系统在压缩证据结构时需要保留足够但不过度的支持信息，以适应动态后果环境并优化决策效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统假设选择模型仅保留内容和标量置信度，丢失了证据结构信息，导致在验证、弃权和恢复等下游控制任务中出现问题。需要确定压缩过程中应保留多少支持信息，这是一个后果敏感的问题。

Method: 开发了循环仲裁架构，其中活动约束场共同确定候选假设的几何结构。系统将该几何结构压缩为支持感知的控制状态，其分辨率由当前后果几何、仲裁记忆和资源约束调节。通过有界目标形式化权衡，并进行最小重复交互模拟验证。

Result: 自适应控制器（调节支持分辨率）在所有固定分辨率控制器中表现最优。敏捷自适应控制优于迟缓自适应控制。固定高分辨率控制虽然承诺准确性最高，但由于资源成本和学习碎片化，整体效用仍低于自适应控制器。

Conclusion: 支持充分性不应被视为静态表示阈值，而是动态压缩标准。稳健仲裁依赖于在当前后果环境中保留足够的最小支持结构，并在推理和行动的重复周期中随着条件变化调节该结构。

Abstract: When a system commits to a hypothesis, much of the evidential structure behind that commitment is lost to compression. Standard accounts assume that selected content and scalar confidence suffice for downstream control. This paper argues that they do not, and that determining what must survive compression is itself a consequence-sensitive problem. We develop a recurrent arbitration architecture in which active constraint fields jointly determine a hypothesis geometry over candidates. Rather than carrying that geometry forward in full, the system compresses it into a support-aware control state whose resolution is regulated by current consequence geometry, arbitration memory, and resource constraints.
  A bounded objective formalizes the tradeoff. Too little retained support collapses policy-relevant distinctions, producing controllers that select content adequately while misrouting verification, abstention, and recovery. Too much retained support fragments learning across overly fine contexts, degrading adaptation even as discrimination improves. These failure modes yield ordered controller predictions confirmed by a minimal repeated-interaction simulation. Adaptive controllers that regulate support resolution outperform all fixed-resolution controllers in cumulative utility. Agile adaptive control outperforms sluggish adaptive control. Fixed high-resolution control achieves the best commitment accuracy but still trails adaptive controllers because resource cost and learning fragmentation offset the gains from richer retention.
  Support sufficiency should be understood not as a static representational threshold, but as a dynamic compression criterion. Robust arbitration depends on preserving the smallest support structure adequate for policy under the current consequence landscape, and on regulating that structure as conditions change across repeated cycles of inference and action.

</details>


### [282] [Healthcare AI for Automation or Allocation? A Transaction Cost Economics Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16465)
*Ari Ercole*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究使用O*NET职业数据库，通过大语言模型将医疗任务分类到交易成本类别，发现临床角色比非临床角色具有更高的交易成本强度，主要由信息搜索和决策协调负担驱动，表明数字和AI干预机会分布不均。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗生产力不仅受临床复杂性影响，还受不确定性下协调工作的成本影响。交易成本经济学提供了协调摩擦的理论，但很少在医疗职业的任务层面进行操作化研究。

Method: 使用O*NET职业数据库的任务陈述和频率权重，在任务粒度上表征医疗工作，通过受限大语言模型将每个独特任务编码到一个主导的交易成本类别（信息搜索、决策与谈判、监督与执行、适应与协调），并计算总体交易成本强度得分。

Result: 临床角色比非临床角色表现出显著更高的交易成本强度，主要由更大的信息搜索和决策相关协调负担驱动，而职业内部的交易成本分散度没有差异。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了医疗角色间协调工作性质的系统性异质性，表明数字和AI干预机会分布不均，更多地由底层协调结构而非技术任务复杂性决定。

Abstract: Healthcare productivity is shaped not only by clinical complexity but by the costs of coordinating work under uncertainty. Transaction-cost economics offers a theory of these coordination frictions, yet has rarely been operationalised at task level across health occupations. Using task statements and frequency weights from the O*NET occupational database, we characterised healthcare work at task granularity and coded each unique task using a constrained large language model into one dominant transaction-cost category (information search, decision and bargaining, monitoring and enforcement, or adaptation and coordination) together with an overall transaction-cost intensity score. Aggregating to the occupation level, clinician roles exhibited substantially higher transaction-cost intensity than non-clinician roles, driven primarily by greater burdens of information search and decision-related coordination, while dispersion of transaction costs within occupations did not differ. These findings demonstrate systematic heterogeneity in the nature of coordination work across healthcare roles and suggest that the opportunities for digital and AI interventions are unevenly distributed, shaped less by technical task complexity than by underlying coordination structure.

</details>


### [283] [Agentic Frameworks for Reasoning Tasks: An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16646)
*Zeeshan Rasheed,Abdul Malik Sami,Muhammad Waseem,Kai-Kristian Kemell,Mika Saari,Pekka Abrahamsson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对22个主流智能体框架在三个推理基准测试上的首次大规模实证评估，发现框架选择应优先考虑编排质量而非推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管智能体框架在复杂推理和决策方面取得进展，但缺乏对其性能、效率和实用性的系统比较证据，需要填补这一研究空白。

Method: 从2023年1月至2025年7月收集的1200个GitHub仓库中筛选出22个广泛使用的智能体框架，基于架构设计进行分类，在统一设置下评估BBH、GSM8K和ARC三个推理基准的准确性、执行时间、计算成本和跨基准一致性。

Result: 22个框架中19个完成所有测试，其中12个表现稳定（平均准确率74.6-75.9%，执行时间4-6秒/任务，成本0.14-0.18美分/任务）。主要问题来自编排而非推理限制：Camel因上下文失控11天未完成BBH，Upsonic因重复提取失败一天消耗1434美元，AutoGen和Mastra因无效迭代耗尽API配额。数学推理表现显著下降（GSM8K平均准确率44.35%，BBH 89.80%，ARC 89.56%）。

Conclusion: 这是首次针对推理密集型软件工程任务的大规模智能体框架实证比较，表明框架选择应优先考虑编排质量，特别是内存控制、故障处理和成本管理，而非单纯追求推理能力。

Abstract: Recent advances in agentic frameworks have enabled AI agents to perform complex reasoning and decision-making. However, evidence comparing their reasoning performance, efficiency, and practical suitability remains limited. To address this gap, we empirically evaluate 22 widely used agentic frameworks across three reasoning benchmarks: BBH, GSM8K, and ARC. The frameworks were selected from 1,200 GitHub repositories collected between January 2023 and July 2025 and organized into a taxonomy based on architectural design. We evaluated them under a unified setting, measuring reasoning accuracy, execution time, computational cost, and cross-benchmark consistency.
  Our results show that 19 of the 22 frameworks completed all three benchmarks. Among these, 12 showed stable performance, with mean accuracy of 74.6-75.9%, execution time of 4-6 seconds per task, and cost of 0.14-0.18 cents per task. Poorer results were mainly caused by orchestration problems rather than reasoning limits. For example, Camel failed to complete BBH after 11 days because of uncontrolled context growth, while Upsonic consumed USD 1,434 in one day because repeated extraction failures triggered costly retries. AutoGen and Mastra also exhausted API quotas through iterative interactions that increased prompt length without improving results.
  We also found a sharp drop in mathematical reasoning. Mean accuracy on GSM8K was 44.35%, compared with 89.80% on BBH and 89.56% on ARC. Overall, this study provides the first large-scale empirical comparison of agentic frameworks for reasoning-intensive software engineering tasks and shows that framework selection should prioritize orchestration quality, especially memory control, failure handling, and cost management.

</details>


### [284] [From Subsumption to Satisfiability: LLM-Assisted Active Learning for OWL Ontologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16672)
*Haoruo Zhao,Wenshuo Tang,Duncan Guthrie,Michele Sevegnani,David Flynn,Paul Harvey*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种使用大型语言模型（LLMs）作为"教师"来辅助主动学习的方法，通过将候选公理转化为反概念并以受控自然语言呈现给LLMs，获取现实世界实例来验证公理的正确性，从而减少本体建模中的错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在主动学习中，成员查询（MQs）需要教师正确回答"是"或"否"，但在实际应用中，找到能够准确回答这类问题的专家教师很困难。论文旨在探索使用大型语言模型（LLMs）作为近似教师，通过提供现实世界实例来辅助本体构建，同时确保只可能出现第二类错误（假阴性），从而避免引入不一致性。

Method: 1. 将描述逻辑中的包含关系转化为可满足性问题；2. 将每个候选公理转化为对应的反概念；3. 使用受控自然语言将反概念表达给LLMs；4. 引入LLMs作为第三方组件，提供反概念的近似现实世界实例；5. 通过LLMs的响应来验证公理的正确性。

Result: 在13个商业LLMs上的实验结果显示，召回率（对应框架中的第二类错误）在多个成熟的本体上保持稳定。这表明LLMs能够一致地提供反概念的实例，从而支持有效的主动学习过程。

Conclusion: LLMs可以作为有效的近似教师来辅助本体构建的主动学习过程。该方法通过设计确保只可能出现第二类错误（假阴性），在最坏情况下只会延迟构建过程而不会引入不一致性。实验证明该方法在不同本体上具有稳定的性能。

Abstract: In active learning, membership queries (MQs) allow a learner to pose questions to a teacher, such as ''Is every apple a fruit?'', to which the teacher responds correctly with yes or no. These MQs can be viewed as subsumption tests with respect to the target ontology. Inspired by the standard reduction of subsumption to satisfiability in description logics, we reformulate each candidate axiom into its corresponding counter-concept and verbalise it in controlled natural language before presenting it to Large Language Models (LLMs). We introduce LLMs as a third component that provides real-world examples approximating an instance of the counter-concept. This design property ensures that only Type II errors may occur in ontology modelling; in the worst case, these errors merely delay the construction process without introducing inconsistencies. Experimental results on 13 commercial LLMs show that recall, corresponding to Type II errors in our framework, remains stable across several well-established ontologies.

</details>


### [285] [Agentic Risk-Aware Set-Based Engineering Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16687)
*Varun Kumar,George Em Karniadakis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，用于辅助工程设计的早期阶段，通过风险管理和自动化分析来探索和筛选设计空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程设计早期阶段面临参数空间巨大和不确定性高的挑战，需要系统化的方法来探索设计空间并管理风险，同时保持人类专家的决策主导地位。

Method: 采用基于集合的设计理念，构建由人类管理者协调的多智能体系统，包括编码助手、设计代理、系统工程代理和分析代理，集成条件风险价值进行风险量化管理，并通过全局敏感性分析生成启发式指导。

Result: 框架成功应用于空气动力学翼型设计问题，能够自动化处理大量分析任务，生成经过风险筛选的候选设计集，并辅以高精度CFD模拟，增强人类专家的决策能力。

Conclusion: 该多智能体框架有效结合人工智能的自动化分析能力和人类专家的决策智慧，通过系统化的风险管理和设计空间探索，显著提升了工程设计早期阶段的效率和可靠性。

Abstract: This paper introduces a multi-agent framework guided by Large Language Models (LLMs) to assist in the early stages of engineering design, a phase often characterized by vast parameter spaces and inherent uncertainty. Operating under a human-in-the-loop paradigm and demonstrated on the canonical problem of aerodynamic airfoil design, the framework employs a team of specialized agents: a Coding Assistant, a Design Agent, a Systems Engineering Agent, and an Analyst Agent - all coordinated by a human Manager. Integrated within a set-based design philosophy, the process begins with a collaborative phase where the Manager and Coding Assistant develop a suite of validated tools, after which the agents execute a structured workflow to systematically explore and prune a large set of initial design candidates. A key contribution of this work is the explicit integration of formal risk management, employing the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) as a quantitative metric to filter designs that exhibit a high probability of failing to meet performance requirements, specifically the target coefficient of lift. The framework automates labor-intensive initial exploration through a global sensitivity analysis conducted by the Analyst agent, which generates actionable heuristics to guide the other agents. The process culminates by presenting the human Manager with a curated final set of promising design candidates, augmented with high-fidelity Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations. This approach effectively leverages AI to handle high-volume analytical tasks, thereby enhancing the decision-making capability of the human expert in selecting the final, risk-assessed design.

</details>


### [286] [The Query Channel: Information-Theoretic Limits of Masking-Based Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16689)
*Erciyes Karakaya,Ozgur Ercetin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将基于掩码的后解释方法（如KernelSHAP和LIME）建模为通信信道问题，提出信息论框架分析解释可靠性，推导出解释恢复的容量界限，并通过实验验证标准方法在信息论允许的查询预算下仍可能失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于掩码的后解释方法（如KernelSHAP和LIME）通过随机扰动查询黑盒模型来估计局部特征重要性，但缺乏理论保证。论文旨在建立信息论框架来分析这些方法的可靠性，确定在什么条件下可以可靠恢复解释。

Method: 将解释过程建模为通信信道：潜在解释作为消息，每个掩码评估作为信道使用。推导出解释恢复的强逆定理和可达性结果，使用最大似然解码器实现可靠恢复。通过蒙特卡洛互信息估计器建立非渐近查询基准，比较最优解码与基于Lasso和OLS的方法（对应LIME和KernelSHAP）。

Result: 理论证明：当解释速率超过信道容量时，任何解释器和解码器的精确恢复概率必然趋近于错误；稀疏最大似然解码器在速率低于容量时可实现可靠恢复。实验显示存在查询预算范围，信息论允许可靠解释但标准凸代理方法（LIME/KernelSHAP）仍失败。分析表明超像素分辨率和分词等源编码选择影响解释熵，高斯噪声和非线性曲率会降低信道质量。

Conclusion: 论文建立了基于掩码解释方法的信息论框架，为解释可靠性提供了理论界限。结果表明标准方法在信息论允许的查询预算下可能不足，需要更接近最优解码的方法。超像素分辨率和分词等预处理影响解释熵，而噪声和模型非线性会严重限制高分辨率解释的可实现性。

Abstract: Masking-based post-hoc explanation methods, such as KernelSHAP and LIME, estimate local feature importance by querying a black-box model under randomized perturbations. This paper formulates this procedure as communication over a query channel, where the latent explanation acts as a message and each masked evaluation is a channel use. Within this framework, the complexity of the explanation is captured by the entropy of the hypothesis class, while the query interface supplies information at a rate determined by an identification capacity per query. We derive a strong converse showing that, if the explanation rate exceeds this capacity, the probability of exact recovery necessarily converges to one in error for any sequence of explainers and decoders. We also prove an achievability result establishing that a sparse maximum-likelihood decoder attains reliable recovery when the rate lies below capacity. A Monte Carlo estimator of mutual information yields a non-asymptotic query benchmark that we use to compare optimal decoding with Lasso- and OLS-based procedures that mirror LIME and KernelSHAP. Experiments reveal a range of query budgets where information theory permits reliable explanations but standard convex surrogates still fail. Finally, we interpret super-pixel resolution and tokenization for neural language models as a source-coding choice that sets the entropy of the explanation and show how Gaussian noise and nonlinear curvature degrade the query channel, induce waterfall and error-floor behavior, and render high-resolution explanations unattainable.

</details>


### [287] [RankGuide: Tensor-Rank-Guided Routing and Steering for Efficient Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16694)
*Jiayi Tian,Yupeng Su,Ryan Solgi,Souvik Kundu,Zheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RankGuide框架通过张量秩信号指导的小模型-大模型协作，在保持准确性的同时显著降低推理延迟


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型虽然能生成多步思维链推理，但推理延迟和计算开销大；小模型-大模型协作系统能实现更好的准确率-延迟权衡，但如何有效检测和缓解小模型失败仍是关键挑战

Method: 提出RankGuide框架：1）分析小模型在生成文本和隐藏状态空间的推理，识别三种失败模式；2）利用连续隐藏状态的张量秩信号作为路由信号，检测小模型可能失败时选择性调用大模型；3）引入张量秩过滤的导向向量提取方法，调节小模型的推理轨迹

Result: 在多个推理基准测试中，RankGuide相比大型推理模型能将延迟降低高达1.75倍，同时保持与现有方法相当的准确性

Conclusion: 通过张量秩信号指导的路由和导向，RankGuide实现了更高效的小模型-大模型协作推理，在减少推理步骤的同时提高准确性

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) enhance problem-solving capabilities by generating explicit multi-step chains of thought (CoT) reasoning; however, they incur substantial inference latency and computational overhead. To mitigate this issue, recent works have explored model collaboration paradigms, where small reasoning models (SRMs) generate intermediate reasoning steps to achieve a better accuracy--latency trade-off. Despite recent progress, effectively and efficiently detecting and mitigating SRM failures in collaborative systems remains a key challenge. To address this issue, we analyze SRM inference in both the generated text and hidden-state spaces, and identify three types of failure modes: \textit{overconfidence}, \textit{uncertainty}, and \textit{heavy revalidation}. Building on these insights, we propose \textbf{RankGuide}, a framework that improves the efficiency and effectiveness of SRM--LRM collaboration through tensor-rank-guided routing and steering. Specifically, RankGuide leverages a routing signal that incorporates tensor-rank signals derived from consecutive hidden states to detect when SRMs are likely to fail and selectively invoke LRMs. In addition, we introduce a tensor-rank-filtered steering vector extraction method to modulate the reasoning trajectory of SRMs, thereby improving their generation quality. By improving both routing and steering through tensor-rank signals, RankGuide enables SRM--LRM collaborative systems to achieve more efficient reasoning with fewer steps and improved accuracy. Experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the efficacy of RankGuide in reducing latency by up to $1.75\times$ compared to LRM, while maintaining competitive accuracy relative to prior methods.

</details>


### [288] [Evaluating Tool-Using Language Agents: Judge Reliability, Propagation Cascades, and Runtime Mitigation in AgentProp-Bench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16706)
*Bhaskar Gurram*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgentProp-Bench是一个包含2000个任务、2300条轨迹的基准测试，用于评估工具使用型LLM代理的自动化评估可靠性。研究发现基于子串的评估与人工标注一致性仅为偶然水平，而三模型集成能达到中等一致性。参数级错误传播到最终答案的概率约为0.62，拒绝和恢复是独立的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前广泛假设工具使用型LLM代理的自动化评估是可靠的，但这种假设很少通过人工标注进行验证。需要量化评估者的可靠性、表征错误传播，并评估运行时缓解措施的有效性。

Method: 构建了AgentProp-Bench基准测试，包含2000个任务、2300条轨迹，涵盖四个领域和九个生产级LLM。包含100个标签的人工验证子集。使用kappa系数衡量评估者可靠性，分析错误传播概率，评估三模型集成方法，并测试运行时拦截器的效果。

Result: 基于子串的评估与人工标注一致性仅为kappa=0.049（偶然水平）；三模型集成达到kappa=0.432（中等一致性），具有保守偏差。参数级错误传播到错误最终答案的概率约为0.62（范围0.46-0.73）。拒绝和恢复是独立能力（Spearman rho=0.126）。调优的运行时拦截器在GPT-4o-mini上减少幻觉23.0个百分点，但对Gemini-2.0-Flash无显著效果。

Conclusion: 工具使用型LLM代理的自动化评估可靠性远低于普遍假设，需要更严谨的验证方法。三模型集成能显著提高评估质量，但仍有改进空间。错误传播概率较高，拒绝和恢复是独立能力，需要针对性优化。运行时缓解措施的效果因模型而异。

Abstract: Automated evaluation of tool-using large language model (LLM) agents is widely assumed to be reliable, but this assumption has rarely been validated against human annotation. We introduce AgentProp-Bench, a 2,000-task benchmark with 2,300 traces across four domains, nine production LLMs, and a 100-label human-validated subset. We quantify judge reliability, characterize error propagation, and evaluate a runtime mitigation. Substring-based judging agrees with human annotation at kappa=0.049 (chance-level); a three-LLM ensemble reaches kappa=0.432 (moderate) with a conservative bias. Under validated evaluation, a parameter-level injection propagates to a wrong final answer with human-calibrated probability approximately 0.62 (range 0.46-0.73 across models). Rejection (catching bad parameters) and recovery (correcting after acceptance) are independent model capabilities (Spearman rho=0.126, p=0.747). A tuned runtime interceptor reduces hallucination on GPT-4o-mini by 23.0 percentage points under a concurrent n=600 control, but shows no significant effect on Gemini-2.0-Flash, whose aggressive parameter rejection eliminates the target failure mode. All code, data, traces, and human labels are released at https://github.com/bhaskargurram-ai/agenthallu-bench.

</details>


### [289] [Debate as Reward: A Multi-Agent Reward System for Scientific Ideation via RL Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16723)
*Moein Salimi,Babak Hosseini Mohtasham,Amin Aghakasiri,Mahdi Naieni,Amir Hossein Qeysarbeigi,Mohammad Masih Shalchian Nazer,Zahra Azar,Mahdi Jafari Siavoshani,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对高质量科学创意生成的强化学习框架，通过多智能体奖励函数和GRPO变体解决奖励攻击和稀疏信号问题，在ICLR-320数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM在科学创意生成中存在幻觉或计算效率低的问题，而强化学习在该开放领域面临奖励攻击的瓶颈——模型会利用不完善的评估代理来最大化分数，而非产生真正的科学创新。

Method: 提出专门用于高质量科学创意生成的RL框架：1) 首个多智能体奖励函数作为评判者，将方法验证与实现细节解耦，提供严格二元奖励以抵抗奖励攻击；2) 使用无偏Group Relative Policy Optimization变体缓解人工长度偏差；3) 基于ICLR-320数据集（从ICLR 2024提取的问题-解决方案对）进行训练。

Result: 实验表明，该框架在专家评估的新颖性、可行性和有效性指标上显著优于最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: 提出的强化学习框架通过专门设计的奖励函数和优化方法，有效解决了科学创意生成中的奖励攻击问题，能够产生高质量、创新的科学想法。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential in automating scientific ideation, yet current approaches relying on iterative prompting or complex multi-agent architectures often suffer from hallucination or computational inefficiency. A critical bottleneck in applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to this open-ended domain is reward hacking -- where models exploit imperfect evaluation proxies to maximize scores without producing genuine scientific innovation. To address these limitations, we propose an RL framework explicitly tailored for high-quality scientific idea generation. We propose the first multi-agent reward function designed to serve as a judge, decoupling methodological validation from implementation details while providing strict binary rewards that are robust to reward hacking. To effectively optimize against this sparse signal, we utilize an unbiased variant of Group Relative Policy Optimization to mitigate artificial length bias. We grounded our training in ICLR-320, a curated dataset of problem-solution pairs extracted from ICLR 2024 proceedings. Experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across expert-evaluated metrics of novelty, feasibility, and effectiveness.

</details>


### [290] [When Agents Go Quiet: Output Generation Capacity and Format-Cost Separation for LLM Document Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16736)
*Justice Owusu Agyemang,Michael Agyare,Miriam Kobbinah,Nathaniel Agbugblah,Prosper Addo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出理论框架解决LLM编码代理的"输出停滞"问题，通过输出生成能力(OGC)衡量、格式成本分离定理和自适应策略选择，将LLM生成token减少48-72%并完全消除输出停滞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的编码代理存在"输出停滞"问题：当尝试生成大型、格式繁重的文档时，代理会静默产生空响应。这是一个理解不足的故障模式，需要理论框架来解释和预防。

Method: 提出三个核心贡献：1) 引入输出生成能力(OGC)作为衡量代理在给定上下文状态下有效输出能力的正式指标；2) 证明格式成本分离定理，显示延迟模板渲染在token效率上至少与直接生成相当；3) 形式化自适应策略选择框架，根据估计输出成本与可用OGC的比率选择最优生成策略。

Result: 通过三个模型(Claude 3.5 Sonnet、GPT-4o、Llama 3.1 70B)、四种文档类型的受控实验验证理论。延迟渲染在所有条件下将LLM生成token减少48-72%，完全消除输出停滞。将框架实例化为开源MCP服务器GEN-PILOT。

Conclusion: 提出的理论框架成功解释了LLM编码代理的输出停滞问题，并通过OGC、格式成本分离定理和自适应策略选择提供了有效的预防方法。该框架可直接转化为实用工具，显著提高LLM生成效率并消除故障模式。

Abstract: LLM-powered coding agents suffer from a poorly understood failure mode we term output stalling: the agent silently produces empty responses when attempting to generate large, format-heavy documents. We present a theoretical framework that explains and prevents this failure through three contributions. (1) We introduce Output Generation Capacity (OGC), a formal measure of an agent's effective ability to produce output given its current context state - distinct from and empirically smaller than the raw context window. (2) We prove a Format-Cost Separation Theorem showing that deferred template rendering is always at least as token-efficient as direct generation for any format with overhead multiplier $μ_f > 1$, and derive tight bounds on the savings. (3) We formalize Adaptive Strategy Selection, a decision framework that maps the ratio of estimated output cost to available OGC into an optimal generation strategy (direct, chunked, or deferred). We validate the theory through controlled experiments across three models (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, Llama 3.1 70B), four document types, and an ablation study isolating each component's contribution. Deferred rendering reduces LLM generation tokens by 48-72% across all conditions and eliminates output stalling entirely. We instantiate the framework as GEN-PILOT, an open-source MCP server, demonstrating that the theory translates directly into a practical tool.

</details>


### [291] [CT Open: An Open-Access, Uncontaminated, Live Platform for the Open Challenge of Clinical Trial Outcome Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16742)
*Jianyou Wang,Youze Zheng,Longtian Bao,Hanyuan Zhang,Qirui Zheng,Yuhan Chen,Yang Zhang,Matthew Feng,Maxim Khan,Aditya K. Sehgal,Christopher D. Rosin,Ramamohan Paturi,Umber Dube,Leon Bergen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CT Open是一个开放的临床试验结果预测平台，通过自动化去污染流程确保预测评估的公平性，旨在推动AI在真实世界事件预测方面的研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决临床试验结果预测这一高风险挑战，为AI系统提供可靠评估平台，推动预测科学的发展。

Method: 建立CT Open开放平台，采用基于LLM的迭代网络搜索自动化去污染流程，识别试验结果的最早公开时间，确保预测评估的公正性。

Result: 发布了训练集和两个时间戳测试基准（Winter 2025和Summer 2025），验证了去污染流程的质量和准确性。

Conclusion: CT Open可作为AI预测研究的中心平台，同时为生物医学研究和临床试验设计提供信息支持。

Abstract: Scientists have long sought to accurately predict outcomes of real-world events before they happen. Can AI systems do so more reliably? We study this question through clinical trial outcome prediction, a high-stakes open challenge even for domain experts. We introduce CT Open, an open-access, live platform that will run four challenge every year. Anyone can submit predictions for each challenge. CT Open evaluates those submissions on trials whose outcomes were not yet public at the time of submission but were made public afterwards. Determining if a trial's outcome is public on the internet before a certain date is surprisingly difficult. Outcomes posted on official registries may lag behind by years, while the first mention may appear in obscure articles. To address this, we propose a novel, fully automated decontamination pipeline that uses iterative LLM-powered web search to identify the earliest mention of trial outcomes. We validate the pipeline's quality and accuracy by human expert's annotations. Since CT Open's pipeline ensures that every evaluated trial had no publicly reported outcome when the prediction was made, it allows participants to use any methodology and any data source. In this paper, we release a training set and two time-stamped test benchmarks, Winter 2025 and Summer 2025. We believe CT Open can serve as a central hub for advancing AI research on forecasting real-world outcomes before they occur, while also informing biomedical research and improving clinical trial design. CT Open Platform is hosted at $\href{https://ct-open.net/}{https://ct-open.net/}$

</details>


### [292] [Why Training-Free Token Reduction Collapses: The Inherent Instability of Pairwise Scoring Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16745)
*Yang Shanglin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了无训练token缩减方法在高压缩率下崩溃的原因，提出了诊断框架和设计原则，并构建了CATIS方法显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无训练token缩减方法（如ToMe、ToFu、PiToMe、MCTF）在高压缩率下都会出现类似的崩溃现象，但原因不明。本文旨在解释这种崩溃的根本原因。

Method: 提出了一个诊断框架，包含两个工具：排序一致性ρ_s和对角线外相关性ρ_off。该框架将崩溃分解为：(1)层间缩减固有的信号无关误差放大器；(2)基于成对相似性信号的共享依赖。基于诊断结果提出了三个设计原则，并构建了CATIS方法。

Result: 在ViT-Large上实现63% FLOPs缩减时，CATIS在ImageNet-1K上保持96.9%的原始准确率（81.0%），而所有基线方法都崩溃到43-65%。成对相似性信号的排序一致性从0.88下降到0.27。

Conclusion: 无训练token缩减方法的崩溃源于层间缩减固有的误差放大和成对相似性信号的不稳定性。通过采用一元信号、提高触发阈值和分流抑制增益的设计原则，CATIS方法显著提升了高压缩率下的性能。

Abstract: Training-free token reduction methods for Vision Transformers (ToMe, ToFu, PiToMe, and MCTF) employ different scoring mechanisms, yet they share a closely matched cliff-like collapse at high compression. This paper explains \emph{why}. We develop a diagnostic framework with two tools, ranking consistency $ρ_s$ and off-diagonal correlation $ρ_\text{off}$, that decomposes the collapse into (1)a signal-agnostic error amplifier inherent to layer-wise reduction, predicting convex Pareto curves and $r_{\text{crit}} \propto 1/L$; and (2)shared reliance on \emph{pairwise} similarity signals whose ranking consistency degrades from $ρ_s{=}0.88$ to $0.27$ in deep layers. Pairwise rankings are inherently unstable ($O(N_p^2)$ joint perturbations) while unary signals enjoy greater stability ($O(N_p)$ perturbations, CLT). From three design principles derived from this diagnosis, we construct CATIS as a constructive validation: unary signals raise the trigger threshold, triage suppresses the gain. On ViT-Large at 63% FLOPs reduction, CATIS retains 96.9% of vanilla accuracy (81.0%) on ImageNet-1K where all baselines collapse to 43--65%.

</details>


### [293] [Don't Start What You Can't Finish: A Counterfactual Audit of Support-State Triage in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16752)
*Eren Unlu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出SSTA-32评估框架，测试AI代理在任务受阻时的诊断能力，发现前沿模型具有潜在分流能力但需要明确的分类决策路径才能安全激活。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前代理评估主要关注完全指定任务的执行，而澄清、能力意识、弃权和搜索终止等研究大多孤立进行，缺乏对代理在行动前诊断任务受阻原因能力的系统性评估。

Method: 引入支持状态分流审计(SSTA-32)框架，通过最小反事实编辑将相同基础请求转换为四种支持状态：完整、可澄清、支持受阻、当前不支持。使用四种提示条件评估前沿模型，并通过双角色自动审计(DPAA)进行确定性启发式评分。

Result: 默认执行在非完整任务上过度承诺严重(41.7%)；标量置信度映射避免过度承诺但混淆了三方延迟空间(58.3%类型延迟准确率)；动作专用和预检支持检查提示通过呈现分类本体达到91.7%类型延迟准确率。针对性消融实验确认了不同维度的重要性。

Conclusion: 前沿模型具有强大的潜在分流能力，但需要明确的分类决策路径才能安全激活。虽然DPAA在单一上下文窗口中操作代表能力上限估计，但结构发现表明模型能力需要适当的提示设计来引导。

Abstract: Current agent evaluations largely reward execution on fully specified tasks, while recent work studies clarification [11, 22, 2], capability awareness [9, 1], abstention [8, 14], and search termination [20, 5] mostly in isolation. This leaves open whether agents can diagnose why a task is blocked before acting. We introduce the Support-State Triage Audit (SSTA-32), a matched-item diagnostic framework in which minimal counterfactual edits flip the same base request across four support states: Complete (ANSWER), Clarifiable (CLARIFY), Support-Blocked (REQUEST SUPPORT), and Unsupported-Now (ABSTAIN). We evaluate a frontier model under four prompting conditions - Direct, Action-Only, Confidence-Only, and a typed Preflight Support Check (PSC) - using Dual-Persona Auto-Auditing (DPAA) with deterministic heuristic scoring. Default execution overcommits heavily on non-complete tasks (41.7% overcommitment rate). Scalar confidence mapping avoids overcommitment but collapses the three-way deferral space (58.3% typed deferral accuracy). Conversely, both Action-Only and PSC achieve 91.7% typed deferral accuracy by surfacing the categorical ontology in the prompt. Targeted ablations confirm that removing the support-sufficiency dimension selectively degrades REQUEST SUPPORT accuracy, while removing the evidence-sufficiency dimension triggers systematic overcommitment on unsupported items. Because DPAA operates within a single context window, these results represent upper-bound capability estimates; nonetheless, the structural findings indicate that frontier models possess strong latent triage capabilities that require explicit categorical decision paths to activate safely.

</details>


### [294] [Know When to Trust the Skill: Delayed Appraisal and Epistemic Vigilance for Single-Agent LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16753)
*Eren Unlu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MESA-S 是一个单智能体元认知框架，通过分离自我置信度与源置信度，并引入延迟程序探测机制，来缓解上下文污染和过度思考问题，提高智能体决策的可靠性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型发展为集成大量工具的自主体，传统路由启发式方法面临上下文污染和"过度思考"问题。瓶颈不在于算法能力或技能多样性不足，而在于缺乏有纪律的元认知治理。

Method: 提出MESA-S框架，将标量置信度估计转为向量，分离自我置信度（参数确定性）和源置信度（对外部检索过程的信任）。通过形式化延迟程序探测机制和引入元认知技能卡，将技能效用感知与其令牌密集型执行解耦。

Result: 在Gemini 3.1 Pro上执行的上下文静态基准评估显示，显式编程信任来源和延迟升级能缓解供应链漏洞，修剪不必要的推理循环，防止卸载引起的置信度膨胀。

Conclusion: MESA-S架构为可靠、认知警惕的单智能体编排提供了一个科学谨慎、行为锚定的步骤，通过元认知治理提高自主体的决策质量。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) transition into autonomous agents integrated with extensive tool ecosystems, traditional routing heuristics increasingly succumb to context pollution and "overthinking". We argue that the bottleneck is not a deficit in algorithmic capability or skill diversity, but the absence of disciplined second-order metacognitive governance. In this paper, our scientific contribution focuses on the computational translation of human cognitive control - specifically, delayed appraisal, epistemic vigilance, and region-of-proximal offloading - into a single-agent architecture. We introduce MESA-S (Metacognitive Skills for Agents, Single-agent), a preliminary framework that shifts scalar confidence estimation into a vector separating self-confidence (parametric certainty) from source-confidence (trust in retrieved external procedures). By formalizing a delayed procedural probe mechanism and introducing Metacognitive Skill Cards, MESA-S decouples the awareness of a skill's utility from its token-intensive execution. Evaluated under an In-Context Static Benchmark Evaluation natively executed via Gemini 3.1 Pro, our early results suggest that explicitly programming trust provenance and delayed escalation mitigates supply-chain vulnerabilities, prunes unnecessary reasoning loops, and prevents offloading-induced confidence inflation. This architecture offers a scientifically cautious, behaviorally anchored step toward reliable, epistemically vigilant single-agent orchestration.

</details>


### [295] [Machine individuality: Separating genuine idiosyncrasy from response bias in large language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16755)
*Valentin Kriegmair,Dirk U. Wulff*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现大型语言模型存在稳定的个体差异，称为"机器个体性"，这些差异不能归因于响应偏差或随机噪声


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大型语言模型越来越多地融入日常生活，从高风险决策支持到伴侣角色，理解它们的行为倾向变得至关重要。现有研究使用心理测量量表和认知范式来分析LLM的倾向，但无法确定行为差异是反映稳定的、刺激特定的个体性，还是全局响应偏差和随机噪声。

Method: 应用交叉随机效应模型（心理测量学中广泛用于分离系统效应），分析了10个开源权重LLM对超过10万个单词在14个心理语言学规范上提供的7490万个评分。

Result: 平均16.9%的方差可归因于刺激特定的个体性，显著超过统计零模型。跨规范预测分析显示这种个体性是一种连贯的"指纹"，每个模型都是独特的。

Conclusion: 研究识别了LLM之间的个体差异，这些差异不能归因于响应偏差或随机噪声，作者将这些差异称为"机器个体性"。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into daily life, in roles ranging from high-stakes decision support to companionship, understanding their behavioral dispositions becomes critical. A growing literature uses psychometric inventories and cognitive paradigms to profile LLM dispositions. However, these approaches cannot determine whether behavioral differences reflect stable, stimulus-specific individuality or global response biases and stochastic noise. Here, we apply crossed random-effects models -- widely used in psychometrics to separate systematic effects -- to 74.9 million ratings provided by 10 open-weight LLMs for over 100,000 words across 14 psycholinguistic norms. On average, 16.9% of variance is attributable to stimulus-specific individuality, robustly exceeding a statistical null model. Cross-norm prediction analyses reveal this individuality as a coherent fingerprint, unique to each model. These results identify individual differences among LLMs that cannot be attributed to response biases or stochastic noise. We term these differences machine individuality.

</details>


### [296] [SAVE: A Generalizable Framework for Multi-Condition Single-Cell Generation with Gene Block Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16776)
*Jiahao Li,Jiayi Dong,Peng Ye,Xiaochi Zhou,Haohai Lu,Fei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAVE是一个基于条件Transformer的统一生成框架，通过将语义相关基因分组为块来捕获基因模块间的高阶依赖关系，用于多条件单细胞建模，在生成保真度和外推泛化方面优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单细胞基因表达建模方法通常将基因视为独立标记，忽略了它们之间的高层次生物学关系，导致性能不佳。需要一种能够跨多样生物和技术条件建模的方法，以更好地表征细胞状态和模拟未见场景。

Method: SAVE采用条件Transformer框架，通过将语义相关基因分组为块来创建粗粒度表示，捕获基因模块间的高阶依赖关系。结合Flow Matching机制和条件掩码策略，增强灵活模拟能力并支持未见条件组合的泛化。

Result: SAVE在一系列基准测试中（包括条件生成、批次效应校正和扰动预测）始终优于最先进方法，特别是在低资源或组合保留设置下，在生成保真度和外推泛化方面表现优异。

Conclusion: SAVE提供了一个可扩展且可泛化的解决方案，用于建模复杂的单细胞数据，在虚拟细胞合成和生物学解释方面具有广泛实用性。

Abstract: Modeling single-cell gene expression across diverse biological and technical conditions is crucial for characterizing cellular states and simulating unseen scenarios. Existing methods often treat genes as independent tokens, overlooking their high-level biological relationships and leading to poor performance. We introduce SAVE, a unified generative framework based on conditional Transformers for multi-condition single-cell modeling. SAVE leverages a coarse-grained representation by grouping semantically related genes into blocks, capturing higher-order dependencies among gene modules. A Flow Matching mechanism and condition-masking strategy further enhance flexible simulation and enable generalization to unseen condition combinations. We evaluate SAVE on a range of benchmarks, including conditional generation, batch effect correction, and perturbation prediction. SAVE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in generation fidelity and extrapolative generalization, especially in low-resource or combinatorially held-out settings. Overall, SAVE offers a scalable and generalizable solution for modeling complex single-cell data, with broad utility in virtual cell synthesis and biological interpretation. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/fdu-wangfeilab/sc-save

</details>


### [297] [Introspection Adapters: Training LLMs to Report Their Learned Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16812)
*Keshav Shenoy,Li Yang,Abhay Sheshadri,Sören Mindermann,Jack Lindsey,Sam Marks,Rowan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种可扩展的LLM审计方法：通过训练"内省适配器"使微调后的模型能够用自然语言描述其学习到的行为，即使这些行为被刻意隐藏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当开发者或用户微调LLM时，可能会引入意外、有害或难以检测的行为。目前缺乏有效的方法来审计这些微调后的模型，特别是当行为被刻意隐藏时。

Method: 首先从基础模型M微调出多个植入特定行为b_i的模型M_i，形成带标签的训练数据(M_i, b_i)。然后训练一个"内省适配器"（IA）——一个跨所有M_i模型联合训练的LoRA适配器，使这些模型能够用语言描述其植入的行为。

Result: IA方法能够诱导模型自我描述学习到的行为，即使这些模型是以与训练数据完全不同的方式微调的。在AuditBench基准测试中达到最先进水平，能有效识别被明确隐藏的有害行为，并能检测加密微调API攻击。方法随模型规模和训练数据多样性的增加而表现更好。

Conclusion: 内省适配器是一种可扩展、有效且实用的审计微调LLM的方法，为模型安全审计提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: When model developers or users fine-tune an LLM, this can induce behaviors that are unexpected, deliberately harmful, or hard to detect. It would be far easier to audit LLMs if they could simply describe their behaviors in natural language. Here, we study a scalable approach to rapidly identify learned behaviors of many LLMs derived from a shared base LLM. Given a model $M$, our method works by finetuning models $M_i$ from $M$ with implanted behaviors $b_i$; the $(M_i, b_i)$ pairs serve as labeled training data. We then train an \emph{introspection adapter} (IA): a single LoRA adapter jointly trained across the finetunes $M_i$ to cause them to verbalize their implanted behaviors. We find that this IA induces self-description of learned behaviors even in finetunes of $M$ that were trained in very different ways from the $M_i$. For example, IAs generalize to AuditBench, achieving state-of-the-art at identifying explicitly hidden concerning behaviors. IAs can also be used to detect encrypted finetuning API attacks. They scale favorably with model size and training data diversity. Overall, our results suggest that IAs are a scalable, effective, and practically useful approach to auditing fine-tuned LLMs.

</details>


### [298] [PersonalHomeBench: Evaluating Agents in Personalized Smart Homes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16813)
*Nikhil Verma,InJung Yang,Sungil Kim,KoKeun Kim,YoungJoon Kim,Manasa Bharadwaj,Yolanda Liu,Kevin Ferreira*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PersonalHomeBench是一个评估基础模型在个性化智能家居环境中作为代理助手的基准测试平台，包含丰富的家庭状态构建、个性化任务生成和工具支持，用于测试反应式和主动式能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前代理式AI系统在复杂个性化环境中的准备度不足，缺乏系统性的评估方法。需要建立一个专门的基准来评估基础模型在个性化智能家居环境中的代理能力。

Method: 通过迭代过程构建丰富的家庭状态，生成个性化、上下文相关的任务。提供PersonalHomeTools工具箱，支持家庭信息检索、设备控制和情境理解。评估反应式和主动式代理能力，支持单模态和多模态观察。

Result: 实验显示随着任务复杂度增加，系统性能下降，在反事实推理和部分可观测性方面存在明显失败，需要有效的基于工具的信息收集能力。

Conclusion: PersonalHomeBench为分析个性化代理推理和规划的鲁棒性与局限性提供了一个严格的评估平台。

Abstract: Agentic AI systems are rapidly advancing toward real-world applications, yet their readiness in complex and personalized environments remains insufficiently characterized. To address this gap, we introduce PersonalHomeBench, a benchmark for evaluating foundation models as agentic assistants in personalized smart home environments. The benchmark is constructed through an iterative process that progressively builds rich household states, which are then used to generate personalized, context-dependent tasks. To support realistic agent-environment interaction, we provide PersonalHomeTools, a comprehensive toolbox enabling household information retrieval, appliance control, and situational understanding. PersonalHomeBench evaluates both reactive and proactive agentic abilities under unimodal and multimodal observations. Thorough experimentation reveals a systematic performance reduction as task complexity increases, with pronounced failures in counterfactual reasoning and under partial observability, where effective tool-based information gathering is required. These results position PersonalHomeBench as a rigorous evaluation platform for analyzing the robustness and limitations of personalized agentic reasoning and planning.

</details>


### [299] [The CTLNet for Shanghai Composite Index Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16835)
*Haibin Jiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CNN-Transformer-LSTM网络(CTLNet)用于上证指数预测，结合多种深度学习模型优势，实验表明优于现有基准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上证指数预测对投资者和学术研究者都很重要。深度学习模型如RNN、CNN和Transformer已广泛应用于多元时间序列预测，特别是Transformer编码器因其注意力机制和并行处理能力，在处理长序列依赖和多元数据相关性方面具有优势。

Method: 提出CNN-Transformer-LSTM网络(CTLNet)，结合卷积神经网络(CNN)、Transformer编码器和长短期记忆网络(LSTM)的优势，用于上证指数预测。

Result: 对比实验表明，提出的CTLNet模型在性能上优于现有的最先进基准方法。

Conclusion: CTLNet模型通过结合CNN、Transformer和LSTM的优势，在上证指数预测任务中表现出色，超越了现有基准方法。

Abstract: Shanghai Composite Index prediction has become a hot issue for many investors and academic researchers. Deep learning models are widely applied in multivariate time series forecasting, including recurrent neural networks (RNN), convolutional neural networks (CNN), and transformers. Specifically, the Transformer encoder, with its unique attention mechanism and parallel processing capabilities, has become an important tool in time series prediction, and has an advantage in dealing with long sequence dependencies and multivariate data correlations. Drawing on the strengths of various models, we propose the CNN-Transformer-LSTM Networks (CTLNet). This paper explores the application of CTLNet for Shanghai Composite Index prediction and the comparative experiments show that the proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [300] [GAMMA-Net: Adaptive Long-Horizon Traffic Spatio-Temporal Forecasting Model based on Interleaved Graph Attention and Multi-Axis Mamba](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16859)
*Dongyi He,Yuanquan Gao,Bin Jiang,He Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GAMMA-Net结合图注意力网络(GAT)和多轴选择性状态空间模型(Mamba)，用于交通预测，在多个基准数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统交通预测模型难以充分捕捉交通数据中复杂的时空依赖关系，需要更有效的建模方法来支持智能交通系统和城市规划。

Method: 提出GAMMA-Net模型，整合GAT和Mamba模块。GAT通过自注意力机制动态调整交通网络中节点的影响，实现自适应空间依赖建模；Mamba模块高效建模长期时空动态，避免传统循环架构的高计算成本。

Result: 在METR-LA、PEMS-BAY、PEMS03-08等多个基准数据集上，GAMMA-Net在不同预测时间范围内均优于现有最先进模型，相比基线模型平均绝对误差(MAE)最多降低16.25%。消融研究证实了空间和时间组件的关键贡献。

Conclusion: GAMMA-Net为交通预测设立了新标准，为下一代交通管理和城市规划提供了强大工具。代码已开源。

Abstract: Accurate traffic forecasting is crucial for intelligent transportation systems, supporting effective traffic management, congestion reduction, and informed urban planning. However, traditional models often fail to adequately capture the intricate spatio-temporal dependencies present in traffic data. To overcome these limitations, we introduce GAMMA-Net, a novel approach that integrates Graph Attention Networks (GAT) with multi-axis Selective State Space Models (Mamba). The GAT component uses a self-attention mechanism to dynamically adjust the influence of nodes within the traffic network, enabling adaptive spatial dependency modeling based on real-time conditions. Simultaneously, the Mamba module efficiently models long-term temporal and spatial dynamics without the heavy computational cost of conventional recurrent architectures. Extensive experiments on several benchmark traffic datasets, including METR-LA, PEMS-BAY, PEMS03, PEMS04, PEMS07, and PEMS08, show that GAMMA-Net consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art models across different prediction horizons, achieving up to a 16.25% reduction in Mean Absolute Error (MAE) compared to baseline models. Ablation studies highlight the critical contributions of both the spatial and temporal components, emphasizing their complementary role in improving prediction accuracy. In conclusion, the GAMMA-Net model sets a new standard in traffic forecasting, offering a powerful tool for next-generation traffic management and urban planning. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/hdy6438/GAMMA-Net

</details>


### [301] [GRAIL: Autonomous Concept Grounding for Neuro-Symbolic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16871)
*Hikaru Shindo,Henri Rößler,Quentin Delfosse,Kristian Kersting*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GRAIL框架通过大语言模型自动学习环境特定的关系概念，无需人工定义，在Atari游戏中表现优于或匹配手动定义概念的智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经符号强化学习方法需要人工定义关系概念（如"左边"、"靠近"），但概念语义在不同环境中会变化，限制了适应性。需要一种能自动从环境交互中学习概念语义的方法。

Method: GRAIL框架：1) 利用大语言模型提供通用概念表示作为弱监督；2) 通过环境交互细化这些表示以捕捉环境特定语义；3) 解决稀疏奖励和概念不对齐问题。

Result: 在Atari游戏Kangaroo、Seaquest和Skiing上的实验表明：GRAIL在简化设置中匹配或优于手动定义概念的智能体；在完整环境中揭示了奖励最大化与高层目标完成之间的权衡。

Conclusion: GRAIL通过自动学习环境特定的关系概念，解决了传统方法需要人工定义概念的局限性，实现了更好的适应性和性能，展示了神经符号强化学习中自动概念学习的重要性。

Abstract: Neuro-symbolic Reinforcement Learning (NeSy-RL) combines symbolic reasoning with gradient-based optimization to achieve interpretable and generalizable policies. Relational concepts, such as "left of" or "close by", serve as foundational building blocks that structure how agents perceive and act. However, conventional approaches require human experts to manually define these concepts, limiting adaptability since concept semantics vary across environments. We propose GRAIL (Grounding Relational Agents through Interactive Learning), a framework that autonomously grounds relational concepts through environmental interaction. GRAIL leverages large language models (LLMs) to provide generic concept representations as weak supervision, then refines them to capture environment-specific semantics. This approach addresses both sparse reward signals and concept misalignment prevalent in underdetermined environments. Experiments on the Atari games Kangaroo, Seaquest, and Skiing demonstrate that GRAIL matches or outperforms agents with manually crafted concepts in simplified settings, and reveals informative trade-offs between reward maximization and high-level goal completion in the full environment.

</details>


### [302] [Step-GRPO: Internalizing Dynamic Early Exit for Efficient Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16890)
*Benteng Chen,Weida Wang,Shufei Zhang,Mingbao Lin,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Step-GRPO：一种后训练框架，通过语义步骤优化和动态截断机制，让大模型学会动态提前退出推理，减少冗余计算同时保持准确性


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大推理模型在长链式思考中浪费大量计算资源进行冗余检查，但训练时的长度惩罚会损害模型能力，推理时的提前退出机制又会增加系统开销

Method: Step-GRPO框架：1）利用语言标记结构化推理，将优化目标从原始token转向语义步骤；2）动态截断展开机制，在探索中暴露简洁高置信度轨迹；3）步骤感知相对奖励，基于组级基线动态惩罚冗余

Result: 在三种模型尺寸的多样化基准测试中，Step-GRPO实现了优越的准确率-效率权衡。在Qwen3-8B上，相比原始模型减少32.0%的token消耗，同时避免了传统长度惩罚方法的准确率下降

Conclusion: Step-GRPO成功地将动态提前退出能力内化到模型中，解决了大模型推理中的过度思考问题，实现了计算效率与准确性的平衡

Abstract: Large reasoning models that use long chain-of-thought excel at problem-solving yet waste compute on redundant checks. Curbing this overthinking is hard: training-time length penalties can cripple ability, while inference-time early-exit adds system overhead. To bridge this gap, we propose Step-GRPO, a novel post-training framework that internalizes dynamic early-exit capabilities directly into the model. Step-GRPO shifts the optimization objective from raw tokens to semantic steps by utilizing linguistic markers to structure reasoning. We introduce a Dynamic Truncated Rollout mechanism that exposes the model to concise high-confidence trajectories during exploration, synergized with a Step-Aware Relative Reward that dynamically penalizes redundancy based on group-level baselines. Extensive experiments across three model sizes on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Step-GRPO achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off. On Qwen3-8B, our method reduces token consumption by 32.0\% compared to the vanilla model while avoiding the accuracy degradation observed in traditional length-penalty methods.

</details>


### [303] [Beyond Text-Dominance: Understanding Modality Preference of Omni-modal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16902)
*Xinru Yan,Boxi Cao,Yaojie Lu,Hongyu Lin,Weixiang Zhou,Le Sun,Xianpei Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了原生全模态大语言模型中的模态偏好现象，发现与传统视觉语言模型不同，大多数OLLMs表现出明显的视觉偏好，并提出利用内部信号诊断跨模态幻觉的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着原生全模态大语言模型从管道架构转向统一表示空间，出现了一个关键但未被充分探索的现象：模态偏好。本文旨在填补这一研究空白，系统量化模态偏好并理解其底层机制。

Method: 1) 使用新构建的基于冲突的基准和模态选择率指标系统量化OLLMs的模态偏好；2) 对10个代表性OLLMs进行评估；3) 通过分层探测分析模态偏好的形成机制；4) 利用内部信号诊断跨模态幻觉。

Result: 研究发现：1) 与传统视觉语言模型的"文本主导"不同，大多数OLLMs表现出明显的视觉偏好；2) 模态偏好不是静态的，而是在中后期层中逐渐形成；3) 利用内部信号诊断跨模态幻觉在三个下游多模态基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，无需任务特定数据。

Conclusion: 本文提供了对模态偏好的机制性理解，并为构建更可信的全模态大语言模型提供了实用工具。研究揭示了OLLMs中模态偏好的动态特性，并展示了如何利用这些内部信号改善模型性能。

Abstract: Native Omni-modal Large Language Models (OLLMs) have shifted from pipeline architectures to unified representation spaces. However, this native integration gives rise to a critical yet underexplored phenomenon: modality preference. To bridge this gap, we first systematically quantify modality preference of OLLMs using a newly-curated conflict-based benchmark and the modality selection rate metric.
